identified_topics.name: MongoDB Certified Associate Developer

identified_topics.name: Attendify: QR-Code Based Attendance App
identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: It demonstrates cross-platform mobile development skills using Flutter/Dart and integrating with Firebase services and local storage (Hive).

identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: This project bridges theoretical computer science algorithms with frontend development, showing how Stack data structures are implemented to solve arithmetic expression conversion.

identified_topics.name: Java & C
identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: They represent the candidate's primary languages for object-oriented programming (Java) and low-level memory operations / foundational coding (C).

identified_topics.name: NodeJS & ExpressJS
identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: These tools were used to build the backend server of the 'Mentor Connect' application, validating the candidate's backend architecture and server-side JS skills.

identified_topics.name: ReactJS
identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: ReactJS is the primary frontend framework used in 'Mentor Connect' and the 'Infix to Postfix Converter'. It tests the candidate's ability to build interactive client-side user interfaces.

identified_topics.name: MySQL & DBMS

identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: It is listed under technical skills, indicating familiarity with data modeling, preprocessing, and predictive algorithms.

identified_topics.name: Coding Contest & Technical Quiz Prizes

identified_topics.name: Class Representative
identified_topics.why_interview_relevant: Demonstrates management capabilities, communication skills, adaptability, and leadership qualities within a student body.

inferred_topics.name: RESTful API Design
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: Since the candidate built a backend server with Express for routing and endpoints, they need to understand API standards, HTTP methods, CORS, status codes, and JSON exchange formats.

inferred_topics.name: Database Schema Design (NoSQL vs. SQL)
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: With background in both MySQL (relational) and MongoDB (document), the candidate is highly likely to face questions about schemas, normalization vs. denormalization, and choosing the right database model.

inferred_topics.name: Authentication & Authorization
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: Apps like 'Mentor Connect' (mentor-mentee registration) and 'Attendify' require user accounts and distinct roles. Understanding JWTs, session tokens, and secure routes is vital.

inferred_topics.name: React State Management & Lifecycle Hooks
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: A major component of React engineering is handling states, props, component mounting/updating, and managing state boundaries in complex layouts like form conversions.

inferred_topics.name: Third-Party API Integration & Webhooks
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: Integrating a scheduling tool like Calendly into a learning platform requires token exchanges, handling asynchronous callbacks or webhooks, and managing rate limits.

inferred_topics.name: Local Storage (Hive) vs. Cloud Database (Firebase)
inferred_topics.why_interview_relevant: Developing mobile apps requires local cache management (Hive) synchronized with cloud data stores (Firebase). It involves offline-first concepts and state sync.

weak_or_missing_areas: No industrial internship or professional experience listed, leaving a gap in understanding real-world corporate development processes, CI/CD, and agile team workflows.
No project details or practical application demonstrating 'Machine Learning' skills, despite listing it under technical competencies.
Lack of relational database (MySQL) utilization in projects, despite DBMS being listed as a top area of interest and MySQL as a skill (all projects use MongoDB, Firebase, or Hive).
Missing deployment details for the backend of 'Mentor Connect' (Node/Express/MongoDB), only showing Vercel hosting for static frontend conversions.
recommended_preparation_topics: Practicing Relational Database SQL queries (Joins, Indexing, Normalization, Transactions) to backup the interest in DBMS.
Deepening Stack algorithm knowledge beyond Infix-to-Postfix conversion (e.g., Parenthesis Matching, Next Greater Element, Stack-based iterative tree traversals).
System Design and Scalability principles for web and mobile platforms, specifically load balancing, caching strategies (Redis), and scaling database write/read operations.
CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, and hosting configurations for multi-tier applications (frontend hosted on Vercel/Netlify and backend hosted on AWS/Heroku/Render).
